observations: Large solar panel with a silver aluminum frame.
Dark monocrystalline cells, appearing to be a half-cut cell design.
Watermark 'NAGOTECH SOLAR' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on the image.
No manufacturer label, brand logo, or model number is visible on the front of the panel.

claims.evidence: The technical specification label on the back is not shown.
While the cell count can be estimated from the front, the configuration is usually confirmed by the model number on the back label.
No Longi branding is visible in photo 0.

risks.risk: The panel may have a much lower wattage than claimed (e.g., 350W-450W).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification sticker on the back.

risks.risk: The panel may be a generic brand rather than Longi.
risks.proof: Photo of the brand name and serial number on the back label.

risks.risk: Internal cell damage or micro-cracks reducing efficiency.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading of the open-circuit voltage (Voc) in direct sunlight.

proof_requests: Photo of the full specification label on the back of the panel.
Close-up photo of any brand markings on the frame or under the glass.
Photo of the junction box and connectors on the back.
response.reason: The seller claims a very high wattage (600W) and a specific premium brand (Longi), but provides no photos of the manufacturer's label to verify these details. Pricing cannot be determined without confirming the actual capacity.
